question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**in**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'A wise counting'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'in'.
 
• The given passage states that Birbal announced his answer that there were **twenty-one thousand,** five hundred, and twenty-three crows in the city. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *Birbal immediately smiled and went up to Akbar. He announced the answer, he said there were twenty-one thousand, five hundred and twenty-three crows **in** the city. When asked how he (3) _____ the answer, Birbal replied, "Ask your men to (4) ______ the number of crows. If there are more, then the relatives of the crows must be visiting them from (5) ______ cities. If there are fewer, then the crows from our city must be visiting their relatives who live outside the city".*
